title: Meta Folds AI Coding Startup Conductor Into its Superintelligence Labs

tickers.name: Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The standalone cloud service for the developer platform that coordinates artificial intelligence software agents will shut down on Nov. 20 as its staff transition to their new parent company. Meta acquired the startup, known as Conductor, to integrate its lauch of multi-agent coding workflows into its Superintelligence Labs (MSL), where CEO Charlie Holtz said the team will build a new interface for the next generation of coding tools. The platform, which currently claims more than 100,000 builders, enables engineers to run several coding agents in parallel and supports tools including Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex.

The acquisition is part of a push by Meta to compete with OpenAI and other labs for dominance in the AI developer tool market. Before the deal, dozens of Meta engineers were already utilizing the Conductor orchestrator, which had raised $22M in funding in March.
